headword: {郵便番号|ゆうびんばんごう}

definitions.explanation: The seven-digit number (three digits, a hyphen, four digits) that identifies a delivery area in Japan, written after the 〒 mark at the start of an address.

examples.japanese: {郵便番号|ゆうびんばんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
{郵便番号|ゆうびんばんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べて→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I looked up the postal code before sending it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{郵便番号|ゆうびんばんごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}っていない→合う：10466_au⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If the address and postal code don't match, delivery can be delayed.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {郵便番号|ゆうびんばんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fill in the postal code
- {郵便番号|ゆうびんばんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to look up a postal code

CULTURAL NOTE:
- A Japanese address is written from the largest unit to the smallest: 〒 and the postal code, then prefecture, city, district, block number, and building. Forms usually have a separate box for the {郵便番号|ゆうびんばんごう}, and entering it often fills in the rest of the ⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧ automatically.
